meta.name: Quality control
meta.about: Every quality gate a change passes through, from a developer's machine to a published release, and which repos each guards. The red gate is the one that does not block merging yet.

kindLabels.rel: stage runs gate; gate guards repo

st_local.desc: Before a commit: lint, precheck and the test suite run locally; AGENTS.md in each repo says which.

st_pr.desc: GitHub Actions on every PR: CodeQL, unit and conformance tests, the CLA check. A PR is expected to pass CodeQL on its first push.

st_release.desc: Ubiquity builds and publishes every element; the drift check updates this web's versions.

q_lint.desc: ESLint rules per repo. In webcomponents the rules ban optional chaining (?.) so elements keep running in older browsers; lint catches it.

q_precheck.desc: haxcms-nodejs's npm run precheck: Prettier, ESLint and the fast tests on the files changed against main. haxcms-php has no precheck; the nodejs one covers files the two share.

q_wtr.desc: web-test-runner suites in real browsers, with accessibility checks, for every element in the monorepo.

q_dddaudit.desc: hax audit: design-system and HAXSchema compliance for an element, run from the CLI before a PR.

q_unit.desc: node:test suites in haxcms-nodejs and the CLI; PHPUnit (about 3,900 tests) in haxcms-php with its committed vendor folder.

q_parity.desc: Conformance tests check both backends against the same OpenAPI specs, so haxcms-nodejs and haxcms-php keep identical behavior. Matching test names on both sides.

q_codeql.desc: GitHub's security analysis (actions and javascript-typescript) on every PR to haxcms-nodejs, haxcms-php and webcomponents. Expected to pass on the first push.

q_audit.desc: Composer audit on haxcms-php and npm audit on the Node repos flag vulnerable dependencies.

q_cla.desc: Every contributor signs the contributor license agreement once; the check runs on each PR.

q_e2e.desc: Playwright runs against the HAXcms UI (site creation, templates, outline operations). Non-gating while its flakiness is characterized; some failures recur across PRs.

q_ubiquity.desc: The release build: every element built, tested and published to npm together, and wc-registry.json regenerated.

q_drift.desc: drift.py pulls the latest source, reruns every generated web and flags new or missing CLI commands, API endpoints, MCP tools, field types, schema parts, skeletons, importers, tutorials, languages and release steps; graph-drift.mjs checks every released part's version against npm and GitHub tags. --strict fails a ubiquity build when anything drifted.

tours.label: From commit to release
tours.message: Every gate a change passes through and which repos it guards.

scenes.caption: Three stages: your machine, the pull request, the release.
Before you commit: lint, precheck, browser tests and the DDD audit.
On the PR: unit tests, API conformance between the two backends, CodeQL, dependency audits, the CLA.
The browser end-to-end suite runs too, but does not gate yet.
At release: Ubiquity ships every element; the drift check keeps this web honest.
